scenarios.name: dt2-sample-trig
scenarios.description: DT2 1.16 with a one-sample card (test-sine-1khz.wav, 48 kHz mono, 1 s): the QA prelude (NO at 0), then Trig 1 down at +60M and up at +100M, 3 s. Needs the card's ready state (tools/ready.py dt2 --card-image) and `coupled-run --card-image`; tools/dt2_sample_check.py runs it and checks the spectrum. The PCM hash is of this firmware, card and cold DSP state.

scenarios.name: dt2-sample-trig-noqa
scenarios.description: As dt2-sample-trig without the NO prelude.
